notes: all windows in local exchange time via IANA zones (DST-correct per date); a bar counts only if fully inside the window
z = bar log return / trailing 30-day sigma (majors) or 7-day sigma (DEX), so regime shifts do not masquerade as seasonality

vol_ratio, tail_ratio compare in-window bars with out-of-window bars of the same token; vol_intensity = mean volume (normalised by its own trailing 30d/7d mean) in-window / out-of-window; volume_share = share of that normalised volume inside the window, compare with time_share
Japanese, HK, UK bank holidays and NYSE early closes are not modelled; CME daily 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance halt not modelled
p-values from day-block bootstrap (B=2000, floor 1/B, so the smallest reportable BH q is ~0.002); BH FDR q across all per-window tests
z winsorised at +-10 for variance ratios and skew; tail counts (|z|>2) use raw z

catalog_dex.note: GeckoTerminal free OHLCV: max 1000 hourly candles per call, fetched around each token's peak (peak-7d window), so the sample is a run-up/crash period, not steady-state trading; z uses a trailing 7-day sigma and the first 24h of each series is dropped; empty hours are absent (gaps break returns). Because the sample is selected around peaks, mean returns drift (see mean_z_all_bars): occurrence-mean tests vs zero are NOT session effects for this pool; use vol/tail/volume ratios (in vs out of window, same tokens) instead.

definitions.crash_onset: detector 1 (research/patterns_hours.py): bar of the largest 1h close-to-close drop between the peak and the first close <= 50% of peak within 168h
definitions.crash_exposure: each crash's candidate bars = every bar after the peak up to the -50% crossing (onset could only have happened there); time exposure = share of those bars in the window, volume exposure = share of their volume
definitions.runner_breakout: bar of the largest 1h close-to-close gain within the 168h before the peak (first 6 bars of the series excluded; launch-peak tokens excluded); runners = research-DB "mooned" cohort, and separately any token rising >=3x into its peak
definitions.runner_exposure: candidate bars = contiguous hourly bars in that pre-peak range
definitions.test: observed count vs sum of per-event exposure probabilities; exact Poisson-binomial two-sided p; BH q across windows within each family

live_rule: state = volatile if in-vs-out vol ratio >= 1.15 and BH q < 0.05; quiet if <= 0.87 and q < 0.05; else normal. Per-token profile for Binance majors (5m stats preferred for half-hour windows), pooled majors for other perps, pooled catalog DEX for launches.
